capabilities: Display tasks from supported third-party services in a dashboard
Authenticate with external task services to fetch tasks
extras: Only one service (Tracks) is currently supported. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Full documentation is hosted outside the README.
problem: Managing tasks in external services requires leaving the vault and switching context to another app.

relations.evidence: Currently, the following services are supported: - Tracks (

summary: Task dashboard that displays tasks from external services such as Tracks inside Obsidian.
